profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Seasoned software engineer building web applications and services for companies of various sizes. Adept at building products from the ground up, learning about large existing projects and contributing to them, presenting technical information to groups, running workshops, and expanding professional knowledge. Passionate toward building effective products and teams.

Engineering sense – Knowing how to detect and avoid antipatterns
Versatile skill set – Working across the stack, from React to database design, with ease
Team player – Ready to do work that isn’t “fun”
Collaborative – Experienced collaborator with an understanding the power of feedback
Technical skill – TypeScript, Node, React, JavaScript, Ramda, GraphQL, AWS, Angular, Redux, D3, CSS, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Vim, SQL, Unix

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Optimizing Minnesota's paid family medical leave system

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.locationName: Alameda County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Built clinical trial management software for clinicians using AI-assisted development tools
• Developed internal web tools for hiring and workforce management
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · React.js · Ruby · React Query

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the platform team building permissions and authentication features.
• Lead the effort to build a permissions system that allowed agencies to share data with other agencies
• Primary contributor to core authentication system and login page
 ◦ Performed a major refactor/cleanup of the code with no regressions or outages resulting
• Main engineering contact for implementing SSO integrations
• Engineering thought leader
 ◦ Educated many teammates about Apollo Client, React, and Cypress through lectures and one on one coaching
• Built a system for generating much of the boilerplate for a new form to accelerate devloper productivity and promote best practices
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · React.js · Apollo GraphQL · GraphQL · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Software Engineer III (Zillow Closing Services) (2019 - 2022)
Maintained consistent source of test data with automated tooling for several teams across the company. Developed features for web products while producing results that precisely match both the technical and design specifications by working closely with both product and design.

Software Engineer III (Trulia brand) (2018 - 2019)
Worked on various tasks for Trulia’s SEO and authentication needs with React and PHP. Built an extremely configurable service using Node, Serverless, and AWS Lambda for the majority of Trulia’s CCPA data compliance needs. I was the tech lead for the project.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: I developed awesome D3 data visualizations and AngularJS apps with heavy ReduxJS use including a very flexible, general purpose, data dashboard and reporting framework that supported data snapshots and embedded widgets. This system was capable of displaying data from thousands of different possible configurations and metric types.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a SQL server CE ORM and DB migration tool in C++ with Microsoft's OLEDB API. 
- Developed an STL-like tree container library and a smart pointer library from scratch. 
- Refactored and debugged various large legacy C++ codebases
- Performed a deep analysis of an under-performing C server and used vi macros with regular expressions to convert large swaths to a more robust, C++ style.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Embedded Systems

volunteerExperiences.description: I am mentoring youth affected by the child welfare system.
